triggers.name: new_message
triggers.title: New message
triggers.help: FIFO queues will allow the trigger to receive messages in order, while the regular queue will be un-ordered.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

triggers.name: new_messages_batch
triggers.title: New messages
triggers.help: FIFO queues will allow the trigger to receive messages in order, while the regular queue will be un-ordered.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

actions.name: delete_message
actions.title: Delete message
actions.description: Delete a message from Amazon SQS
actions.help: Deletes the specified message from the specified queue.

actions.name: delete_messages_batch
actions.title: Delete messages
actions.help: Deletes the specified messages from the specified queue.

actions.name: receive_message
actions.title: Receive message
actions.description: Receive message from the specified queue using Amazon SQS
actions.help: Retrieves one or more messages (up to 10), from the specified queue. Non-FIFO queues might not receive more than what is specified.

actions.name: send_message
actions.title: Send message
actions.description: Send a message to the specified queue using Amazon SQS
actions.help: Delivers a message to the specified queue.

actions.name: send_messages_batch
actions.title: Send messages
actions.description: Send messages to the specified queue using Amazon SQS
actions.help: Delivers the specified messages as a batch to the specified queue. The sum of all the individual message size should not exceed 256 KB.

input.name: QueueUrl
input.label: Queue
input.hint: Select the Amazon SQS queue to which a message is sent.
